{text:body}

Nowhere on the Redcliffe Peninsula is far from Moreton Bay, and the salt in the air is hard on roofs. Ordinary screws rust, flashings pit and cheap gutters can start leaking within a few years in Scarborough, Woody Point or along the Margate foreshore. When we replace metal here we use Colorbond Ultra, which BlueScope makes for homes near the coast, with stainless or class 4 fasteners to match. The peninsula has plenty of 1960s and 70s brick and fibro homes with tiled roofs, plus old beach houses that have been extended a room at a time. On those we often find two or three roofs joined by tired flashing, and that join is usually where the water gets in. We also work on unit blocks and townhouses along the waterfront, and we're happy to deal with your body corporate or strata manager directly. Clontarf and Kippa-Ring are part of our regular run as well.
